name: redirect-404-helper-for-ecwid-workspace
description: Dev workspace for the Redirect & 404 Helper for Ecwid WordPress plugin (wp-env local WordPress).

scripts.env:activate: wp-env run cli wp plugin activate redirect-404-helper-for-ecwid
scripts.env:deactivate: wp-env run cli wp plugin deactivate redirect-404-helper-for-ecwid
scripts.env:status: wp-env run cli wp plugin list
